metadata.title: Understanding Transformer Attention Mechanisms in 5 Minutes
metadata.reference_summary: Transformers replaced recurrence with self-attention, allowing parallel processing of sequential data. The core mechanism computes Query, Key, and Value projections using scaled dot-product attention: softmax of Q times K transpose divided by the square root of dimension d_k, multiplied by V. Multi-head attention projects vectors into multiple subspaces to capture diverse relational context. Positional encodings provide sequence order without recurrence. This architecture forms the basis of models like BERT and GPT.

transcript.text: [Music] welcome back to the channel today we are diving into transformer attention mechanisms in under five minutes
before transformers were introduced in 2017 sequential models like RNNs and LSTMs dominated NLP
however recurrent neural networks had a fundamental bottleneck they processed tokens sequentially step by step
this prevented parallel computation across GPUs and caused catastrophic forgetting on long range dependencies
the seminal paper Attention Is All You Need changed everything by proposing self attention
so what exactly is self attention at its core self attention allows every token in a sentence to interact with every other token
instead of waiting for information to propagate through hidden states all tokens attend to each other simultaneously
to compute self attention we first project each input embedding into three distinct vectors
these vectors are called the Query the Key and the Value
think of Query as what a word is searching for Key as a label of what it contains and Value as the actual payload
the attention score is computed using the scaled dot product formula
we take the dot product of the Query matrix Q with the Key matrix K transpose
then we scale down the result by dividing by the square root of d_k where d_k is the dimension of the keys
why do we scale down because as dimension grows the dot products grow large in magnitude pushing softmax into regions of tiny gradients
next we apply a softmax function to obtain normalized attention weights that sum to one
finally we multiply these attention weights by the Value matrix V yielding the weighted contextual representations
now single head attention might only focus on one type of relationship such as syntactic agreement
to solve this the authors introduced Multi Head Attention
multi head attention projects queries keys and values into multiple lower dimensional representation subspaces
each head attends to different contextual information like syntactic parsing semantic roles or coreference resolution
the outputs of all heads are concatenated together and projected through a final linear projection layer
another crucial puzzle piece is positional encodings
because attention is permutation invariant a bag of words would yield the same output without order cues
sinusoidal or learned positional embeddings are added to the input token vectors to encode sequential positioning
today every modern large language model including GPT BERT LLaMA and Gemini is built on this foundation
in summary self attention enables constant path lengths between tokens massive parallel training and expressive contextual modeling
thanks for watching don't forget to like and subscribe for more deep learning breakdowns [Music]
